messages:
maria: quick proposal — adaptive notify based on burst token budget. idea: if a tenant consumes >X% of their monthly token budget in a short window we temporarily elevate notify priority (for eg next 15m) and then decay instead of persistent noisy alerts. motivation: avoid long SLO flaps when large imports or onboarding runs. include console toggle + API flag.

raj: can you sketch the rule & API? how do we compute 'burst'? per-tenant or per-route?

maria: primary is per-tenant, per-route optional. burst = tokens_used_over_window / baseline where baseline = rolling 24h median tokens/min. if burst ratio > 3 -> state 'bursting' for 15m. notify level up for that window, then linear decay over next 60m. will emit telemetry events `burst.start` and `burst.end`.

owen: SRE: main concern — don't let this mask real errors. need a fuse: only apply adaptive notify when current SLO error rate < alert_rate_threshold (e.g., 0.5%) OR when error rate change direction is decreasing. Also require audit logs and ability to opt-out per-org. runbook required.

tayler: DevEx: Console UX thoughts — add a compact 'Adaptive burst notify' card in SLO notify panel showing: recent token chart, burst score, controls (enable, threshold, window, decay). default OFF, rollout opt-in. API: `notify.adaptive_burst.{enabled,threshold,window_mins,decay_mins}`

maria: proto config snippet:
```json
{"adaptive_notify": {"enabled": true, "threshold": 3, "window_mins": 15, "decay_mins": 60}}
```

raj: routing: route to same escalation chain but annotate alerts with `burst=true` metadata so recipients can filter or mute. also ensure alerting tokens/outputs don't count toward burst computations (avoid feedback loop).

alisa: CS: customers have asked for "quiet backoff" during big data imports — this mapping helps. need clear docs and a migration plan for Dedicated customers who pin SLOs and expect no silent changes.

oncall-bot: INF ticket INF-4723 created by owen: add runbook, dashboards, and simulated traffic test harness.

deploy-bot: feature-flag `burst-notify` rolled to staging (canary-3) :rocket:

maria: next steps — RFC at https://go/reports/slo-burst (draft). raj please draft API schema, tayler mock console card, owen add SRE checks & runbook, i'll own rollout plan. thoughts? :thumbsup:
